relationships.subject: Caspase-1
relationships.evidence_quote: During the process of pyroptosis, the Caspase-1-mediated cleavage at ASP275 initiate the proteolysis of GSDMD

relationships.subject: ATP
relationships.evidence_quote: When ATP binds to the purinergic receptor P2X ligand-gated ion channel 7 (P2X7R), it opens the channel for Ca2+ and Na+ influx, causing rapid depolarization and subsequently triggering cellular pyroptosis

relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: A notable finding is a positive correlation between the levels of NLRP3-mediated pyroptosis in OA patients’ cartilage and the severity of the disease (187).

key_findings: Review: NLRP3/caspase-1/GSDMD-mediated pyroptosis in chondrocytes, synoviocytes and macrophages drives OA progression; NF-κB, P2X7R, AMPK, Nrf2/HO-1 and HIF-1α regulate it.
